sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK identifies Shamoon as wiper malware that leverages RawDisk and Filerase for data wiping tasks.
MITRE ATT&CK identifies KillDisk as malware that can overwrite and destroy data and later evolved into stand-alone wiper/ransomware variants.

curator_note: Shared destructive-wiper behavior only, not lineage.
confidence_reason: Both wiper behaviors are directly documented in MITRE ATT&CK.
